title: hieracium bifidum subsp. senile
intro: Hieracium bifidum subsp. senile, commonly known as old man's featherfew, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae) and is native to Europe and parts of Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium bifidum subsp. senile include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
